sentences.japanese: 私のパソコンは何かの役に立つはずだ。
sentences.english: My computer has got to be useful for something.

sentences.japanese: 君の助言はいつも私の役に立つ。
sentences.english: Your advice is always helpful to me.

sentences.japanese: 君が僕に教えてくれた情報はあまり役に立たない。
sentences.english: The information you gave me is of little use.

sentences.japanese: 繰り返すことが物事を覚えるのに役に立つ。
牛はこの国では他のどんな動物よりも役に立つ。
sentences.english: Cows are more useful than any other animal in this country.
